article_manifest.title: Mali: Alger dénonce l'«alliance» des indépendantistes du FLA avec les «terroristes» du Jnim
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Alger dénonce l'«alliance» des indépendantistes du FLA avec les «terroristes» du Jnim
article_manifest.summary: Le ministre algérien des Affaires étrangères a tenu des propos très virulents contre le Front de libération de l'Azawad (FLA), lors d'une conférence de presse jeudi 26 novembre à Alger. Ahmed Attaf a dénoncé l'alliance des rebelles indépendantistes du nord du Mali avec les « groupes terroristes », à savoir les jihadistes du Groupe de soutien à l'islam et aux musulmans (Jnim, lié à al-Qaïda).

article_manifest.title: Bamako face à l’ Ingérence de l’Ukraine aux côtés des groupes armés du Sahel
article_manifest.original_title: Bamako face à l’ Ingérence de l’Ukraine aux côtés des groupes armés du Sahel
article_manifest.summary: La question du soutien de Kiev aux groupes armés actifs dans la bande sahélo-saharienne suscite une vive préoccupation au sein de l’opinion publique et des chancelleries de la région. Alors que les pays de l’Alliance des États du Sahel (AES) font face à des défis sécuritaires majeurs, plusieurs éléments récents tendent à documenter l’implication d’acteurs ukrainiens sur le terrain malien, poussant les autorités de Bamako à réclamer des mesures fermes pour préserver leur souveraineté.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The FAMa are intensifying their offensives...
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Les FAMa intensifient leurs offensives...
article_manifest.summary: Mali: The FAMa are intensifying their offensives in Kayes and around Dandougou. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are continuing their offensive operations as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. .

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: 181 drones and other military equipment seized at Ouagadougou Airport
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : 181 drones et d’autres équipements militaires saisis à l’Aéroport de Ouagadougou
article_manifest.summary: Surveillance and reconnaissance drones, communications equipment, military uniforms and clothing. This is the batch of equipment intercepted by the Special Customs Brigade at Ouagadougou Airport this Wednesday. "The intercepted equipment includes various items of military hardware, Starlink satellite communication terminals and 181 drones, with an estimated value of over 80 million CFA francs," stated Burkina Faso Customs in a press release.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Mali Remains Strategic for Russia Despite Heavy Losses, Investigator Says
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Mali Remains Strategic for Russia Despite Heavy Losses, Investigator Says
article_manifest.summary: Russia is unlikely to pull out of Mali despite losing more than 10 percent of its forces there, an investigator who tracks Russian military deployments told RFI. Lou Osbourn co-founded All Eyes On Wagner, a collective of journalists and cybersecurity analysts. She said the losses prove that Russian fighters are taking part in operations alongside Malian troops and that "Africa remains an area of interest for Moscow".

article_manifest.title: MALI: An ka Tonka duguden dɔ lamɛn JNIM ka kankarimada kan, u bɛ ka fɔ ko dugudenw ka dugu in bila
article_manifest.original_title: MALI: An ka Tonka duguden dɔ lamɛn JNIM ka kankarimada kan, u bɛ ka fɔ ko dugudenw ka dugu in bila
article_manifest.summary: Mali la, nin y'a tile damadɔ ye ni kankarimada-dantigɛli dɔ bi ka yara bɔlɔlɔ foroba kumanyɔrɔw sanfɛ, o dantigɛli min kɔnɔ a fɔlen lon ko bi Novembre kalo tile 27 dilen bɛ Tonka-kaw ma u ka Dugu in bila. Tonka ye Mali Kɔrɔnyanfan dugu dɔ ye Tombouctou mara kɔnɔ, yen min yɛrɛ la bɔlɔlɔ sanfɛ kumanfɔla Sinfin Mariam Cissé fagara Salon Novembre kalo la, ani Dugu in mɔgɔ lakodoni wɛrɛw o kɔ.

article_manifest.title: Securing the territory: several terrorists neutralised and equipment seized during FAMa operations
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurisation du territoire : plusieurs terroristes neutralisés et du matériel saisi lors d’opérations des FAMa
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the nation that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. On Wednesday, 25 November 2026, the FAMa carried out ground and air offensive operations in several areas of the national territory.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The army announces strikes against terrorist groups in several regions
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : l'armée annonce des frappes contre des groupes terroristes dans plusieurs régions
article_manifest.summary: The FAMa (Malian Armed Forces) have announced that they eliminated a large number of terrorists during operations carried out on Wednesday and Thursday across Mali. A statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces, published on Friday, 27 November, reports this information. .

article_manifest.original_title: Bamako : deux jeunes cambrioleurs arrêtés avec 20 millions de FCFA de bijoux
article_manifest.summary: Bamako: Two young burglars arrested with CFA 20 million worth of jewellery The Sabalibougou police station has arrested two young men, aged 21 and 22, suspected of burgling a house in Baco-Djicoroni Golf. The police recovered jewellery estimated to be worth 20 million CFA francs. The two suspects, identified by their initials L.T.

article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Alger dénonce l’alliance du FLA avec les jihadistes du Jnim
article_manifest.summary: L’Algérie hausse le ton face aux indépendantistes de l’Azawad, dénonçant leur rapprochement avec le Jnim. Le ministre Ahmed Attaf écarte toute reprise de la médiation et s’inquiète de la multiplication des ingérences étrangères. Publié aujourd'hui à 11h07, modifié à 12h17 Lecture : 3 minutes.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso seeks Nigeria’s partnership against terrorism, trafficking
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso seeks Nigeria’s partnership against terrorism, trafficking
article_manifest.summary: Burkinabe Minister of Security, Mahamadou Sana and Nigeria’s Ambassador to Burkina Faso, Syndoph Endoni during talks on security cooperation between both countries By Luminous Jannamike ABUJA — Burkina Faso has pledged to strengthen security cooperation with Nigeria to tackle terrorism, drug trafficking, human trafficking and other cross-border crimes threatening stability in West Africa.

article_manifest.title: Sahel Miners Embrace Tech to Combat Insurgents
article_manifest.original_title: Sahel Miners Embrace Tech to Combat Insurgents
article_manifest.summary: Mining companies operating across West Africa are increasing security spending and investing in advanced technology as insurgent violence, political instability and cyberattacks threaten production and supply chains. London-based Endeavour Mining, which derives nearly 30 per cent of its production from two mines in military-led Burkina Faso, has included the possibility of completely shutting down both facilities in its contingency plans.

article_manifest.title: Sanam (Tillabéri): A terrorist attack on the National Guard leaves 13 dead and several attackers neutralised
article_manifest.original_title: Sanam (Tillabéri): une attaque terroriste contre la Garde nationale fait 13 morts et plusieurs assaillants neutralisés
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, 26 November (ANP) – The Niger National Guard (GNN) post in Sanam, in the department of Abala (Tillabéri), was the target on Thursday, 26 November 2020, of a terrorist attack carried out by numerous heavily armed assailants, according to a statement from the Ministry of National Defence published on Thursday evening. This attack resulted in heavy casualties among the ranks of the Defence and Security Forces (DSF).

article_manifest.title: Armed men kill 13 guards in 'terrorist attack' in western Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Armed men kill 13 guards in 'terrorist attack' in western Niger
article_manifest.summary: Armed men on Thursday killed at least 13 Nigerien guards in an attack in the restive Tillaberi region in western Niger, the defence ministry said in a statement. The Nigerien National Guard was targeted "by a terrorist attack carried out by a large group of heavily armed assailants," the ministry said in a statement read on public television. Niger, ruled by a military junta since a 2023 coup, is battling violence by jihadists linked to Al-Qaeda and the Islamic State group, with thousands killed over the last decade.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Following the arrival of the army and Africa Corps, JNIM threatens to blockade Tonka
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : après l’arrivée de l’armée et d’Africa Corps, le Jnim menace Tonka de blocus
article_manifest.summary: Mali: Following the arrival of the army and Africa Corps, JNIM threatens to impose a blockade on Tonka In northern Mali, the jihadist group JNIM is threatening to impose a blockade on the trading town of Tonka. This show of force comes a month after the arrival of the Malian army and its Russian allies from Africa Corps. .

article_manifest.title: SORAZ DONATES FOUR DT MOTORBIKES TO THE INTERREGIONAL JUDICIAL POLICE SERVICE IN ZINDER
article_manifest.original_title: LA SORAZ REMET QUATRE MOTOS DT AU SERVICE INTERREGIONAL DE LA POLICE JUDICIAIRE DE ZINDER
article_manifest.summary: On Monday, 16 November 2020, the Zinder Refining Company (SORAZ) held a ceremony to donate four (4) motorbikes to the Interregional Criminal Investigation Department (SIRPJ) of the city of Zinder. This initiative is part of SORAZ's commitment to supporting the security forces in carrying out their duties to protect people and property, and represents a further practical example of cooperation between the company and local authorities.

article_manifest.title: Loin du front ukrainien, la Russie paie un lourd tribut au Sahel
article_manifest.original_title: Loin du front ukrainien, la Russie paie un lourd tribut au Sahel
article_manifest.summary: Une fuite de données et cinq journalistes auront été nécessaires au Guardian pour dresser ce bilan. Selon une enquête du quotidien britannique parue le 24 novembre, au moins 349 ressortissants russes ont perdu la vie au Mali entre septembre 2023 et septembre 2026. Soit environ une perte tous les trois jours que le journal attribue majoritairement aux combats de paramilitaires russes dans ce pays du Sahel.

Nigerien police officers take part in a special US programme, 13 April 2018. Stock photo.

article_manifest.title: PANDEF seeks police, DSS probe into attack on Omo-Agege’s campaign team
article_manifest.original_title: PANDEF seeks police, DSS probe into attack on Omo-Agege’s campaign team
article_manifest.summary: The Pan Niger Delta Forum (PANDEF) has called on the Department of State Services (DSS) and the police to investigate the killing of two aides of former Deputy Senate President, Ovie Omo-Agege, and two others during a political rally in Delta State. PANDEF also urged security agencies to identify and prosecute those who masterminded, sponsored or participated in the attack, which occurred on Monday at Uduere community in Ughelli North Local Government Area of the state.

article_manifest.title: At least 13 Niger soldiers killed in Sanam armed attack
article_manifest.original_title: At least 13 Niger soldiers killed in Sanam armed attack
article_manifest.summary: At least 13 members of Niger’s National Guard have been killed and 20 wounded in an attack on their compound in Sanam, in the west of the country, the Defence Ministry has said. In a statement read on state television, the ministry said the attack on Thursday was carried out by “numerous heavily armed assailants”, referring to the incident as a “terrorist attack”.

article_manifest.title: DÉFENSE ET SÉCURITÉ : Assimi Goïta réaffirme le cap de la montée en puissance des FAMa, l’héritage du Général Sadio Camara au cœur de la refondation militaire
article_manifest.original_title: DÉFENSE ET SÉCURITÉ : Assimi Goïta réaffirme le cap de la montée en puissance des FAMa, l’héritage du Général Sadio Camara au cœur de la refondation militaire
article_manifest.summary: MALI : Sous le leadership d’Assimi Goïta, la modernisation de l’armée demeure une priorité nationale À Koulouba, le 24 novembre 2026, le Président de la Transition, Chef suprême des Armées, le Général d’armée Assimi Goïta, a réuni les principaux responsables du commandement militaire et des services de défense et de sécurité. Une rencontre stratégique qui traduit la volonté des plus hautes autorités de poursuivre la modernisation de l’outil de défense, de renforcer la coordination opérationnelle et de consolider les acquis enregistrés sur le terrain.

article_manifest.title: Diéma: Official Presentation of the National Flag to the Village Chief
article_manifest.original_title: Diéma: Remise officielle du Drapeau National au Chef de Village
article_manifest.summary: Diéma, 26 November (AMAP) In a solemn atmosphere filled with pride, the official ceremony for the handover of the national flag to the new village chief of Diéma, Cheicknè Sissoko, took place on Thursday in Diéma, in the presence of the 2nd Deputy Prefect, Attayoub Ould Mohamed, who was accompanied by the Sub-Prefect of Dioumara, Mamadou Tiéna Boré, the 1st Deputy Mayor of Diéma, Abdoulaye Touré, and representatives of the Armed Forces.

article_manifest.title: Niger: 13 soldiers killed in a new terrorist attack in Sanam (Tillabéri)
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : 13 soldats tués dans une nouvelle attaque terroriste à Sanam (Tillabéri)
article_manifest.summary: On Thursday, 26 November 2020, the Niger National Guard (GNN) position in Sanam, in the department of Abala (Tillabéri region), was the target of a terrorist attack carried out by "numerous heavily armed attackers", the Ministry of National Defence announced in a statement issued in the evening. According to the same source, the provisional toll stands at 13 soldiers killed and 20 injured, including several serious cases who were evacuated for medical treatment.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike several terrorist positions and neutralise at least a dozen fighters
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent plusieurs positions terroristes et neutralisent au moins une dizaine de combattants
article_manifest.summary: On 23 and 24 November 2026, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out a series of air operations and targeted strikes in several regions of Mali. These actions, carried out as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, resulted in the neutralisation of at least a dozen terrorists and the disabling of seven motorcycles used by armed terrorist groups.

article_manifest.title: 21st Digital Week: Disinformation, a major threat to the AES confederation area
article_manifest.original_title: 21ᵉ Semaine du numérique : La désinformation, une menace majeure pour l’espace confédéral AES
article_manifest.summary: 21st Digital Week: Disinformation, a major threat to the AES confederal area On the eve of the official closing of the 21st edition of Digital Week, on Thursday, 26 November, a panel was dedicated to cybersecurity in the confederal area of the Alliance of Sahel States (AES). . Under the theme ‘Cybersecurity and digital trust in the face of cross-border threats’, the discussions enabled the various panellists to explore possible solutions to better prevent cyber threats and organise the response in the event of an attack.

article_manifest.title: San: the police station and the CAP targeted by an attack
article_manifest.original_title: San : le commissariat et le CAP ciblés par une attaque
article_manifest.summary: The police station and the educational activity centre in San were attacked on Tuesday, 24 November 2020, at around 8 p.m. The CAP caretaker lost his life during the attack, according to local sources. They added that a police officer and a soldier were injured.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Foreigners accommodated or employed under the supervision of the authorities
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : les étrangers hébergés ou employés sous surveillance des autorités
article_manifest.summary: The Malian authorities are stepping up the registration of foreign nationals present on their territory, calling on the population to report to the security forces those who are being hosted, accommodated or employed by private individuals, in a context marked by the influx of people deported from Guinea. . In a statement dated 25 November 2026, the Crisis Coordination and Management Centre (CECOGEC) calls on the public to report such situations to the nearest police station or gendarmerie brigade.

article_manifest.title: Sahel Insurgents Use Low-Cost Drones to Strike Military Targets: Report
article_manifest.original_title: Sahel Insurgents Use Low-Cost Drones to Strike Military Targets: Report
article_manifest.summary: Insurgents in Mali and elsewhere in the Sahel are adapting off-the-shelf drones that cost a few hundred dollars to strike military vehicles and threaten aircraft worth millions, Reuters reported. In Mali, separatists and al-Qaeda-linked militants have used commercially available drones to strike military vehicles and airfields defended by Malian troops and Russian paramilitary forces.

article_manifest.title: Mali – Gestion des personnes refoulées de Guinée : le CECOGEC appelle à la vigilance et au recensement des ressortissants étrangers
article_manifest.original_title: Mali – Gestion des personnes refoulées de Guinée : le CECOGEC appelle à la vigilance et au recensement des ressortissants étrangers
article_manifest.summary: Bamada.net – Dans le cadre du dispositif de gestion des personnes refoulées de Guinée, les autorités maliennes renforcent les mesures d’identification, de recensement et d’accompagnement des personnes concernées. À travers un communiqué publié le 25 novembre 2026, le Centre de Coordination et de Gestion des Crises (CECOGEC) invite les populations à collaborer activement avec les forces de sécurité afin de faciliter le regroupement et la prise en charge des personnes encore dispersées sur le territoire national.
